```{R}
#| label: load-pkg-data
#| message: false

install.packages("kableExtra")
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(patchwork)

ai_salary_majors <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-20/ai_salary_majors.csv')
major_occupations <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-20/major_occupations.csv')
```

```{R}
glimpse(ai_salary_majors)
```

```{R}
#| label: distribution-visualization

ggplot(ai_salary_majors, aes(x = ai_exposure)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of AI exposure across majors",
    x = "AI exposure (how much a major’s typical jobs rely on abilities related 
    to common AI applications)",
    y = "Number of majors"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(ai_salary_majors, aes(x = median_starting_salary)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5000, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(ai_salary_majors$median_starting_salary),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of median starting salary across majors",
    x = "Median salary one year after graduation",
    y = "Number of majors"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
